scope: Coverage focuses on administrator-policy grants and administrator-user credential provisioning. It does not claim to detect all 81 exploit modules, remote workload execution, or every payload transport.
severity: Dual-use provisioning has legitimate administrative uses; hostile criticality would overstate the evidence. Atom and any-of wrapper for the grant are one observation; the account/key provisioning composite is the second independent claim.
limitations: The provisioning composite establishes same-file co-occurrence, not that the operations target one identity.
Policy matching uses source-local complete literal provenance; opaque dynamic values and unsupported SDK argument representations can remain undetected.
Cross-platform source rules target Unix and Windows without an invented ecosystem gate.
